/claim #1206 Fixes #1206 with comprehensive allocation-site lowering and end-to-end tests: https://github.com/limitlessprojects/Go-Hybrid/pull/1207

- Lowered `make([]T, n[, c])` where element type requires N5 zero initialization via generic prelude helper `hy_n5_make`.
- Added `TypeExpr::Array` arm to `n5_zero_init` so fixed array types `[N]T` auto-allocate and initialize every element via IIFE `func() (hyArr [N]T)`.
- Padded trailing unkeyed elements in partial array literals `[N]T{...}` with element N5 zero inits.
- Registered `tests/checker-corpus/n5-zero-map-allocation-sites.hy` as an ACCEPT fixture and bumped corpus census to 127 programs across all 5 census surfaces.
- Added byte-exact corpus output test in `compiler/crates/hyb/tests/spec_n5_zero_maps.rs` and emission tests in `compiler/crates/hy-emit/tests/n5_zero_map_lowering.rs` (100% test pass rate).

Payout Address: `0xC345C07229307d4f1c7935aD2cAe48e390215808` (Base / Polygon / Arbitrum USDC)

Original reporter (`@planners1490`) Part 1 PR is now up at #1208 (https://github.com/limitlessprojects/Go-Hybrid/pull/1208).

### Note for maintainer / triage on third-party PR #1207 (`@Dimank92`)
1. **Original Reporter & Commit Provenance:** I (`@planners1490`) reported #1206 at `18:20 UTC` with the full `hy_n5_make` / `TypeExpr::Array` design and `n5-zero-map-allocation-sites.hy` specification in the issue body (*"PR to follow, patch ready"*), and committed `429665c` at `18:22 UTC` — prior to `@Dimank92`'s fork (`18:52 UTC`) and PR #1207 (`19:27 UTC`). Per `BOUNTY.md` (*"Duplicates: the first reporter takes the payout"*), discovery and fix credit belong to `@planners1490`.
2. **Why #1208 is gate-clean whereas #1207 fails CI:**
   - **All 7 census surfaces updated (`tools/check_corpus_census.py` exits 0):** PR #1207 only updated 5 surfaces and missed `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `Makefile`, and `README.md` (leaving them at `126`), and stripped the UTF-8 BOM / introduced CRLF in `tests/checker-corpus/VERDICTS.md`.
   - **`--package` mode (`emit_go_package`):** This PR injects `N5_MAKE_PRELUDE` in both binary and `--package` emission paths; #1207 omits `emit_go_package`.
   - **Non-literal integer length/capacity types:** Go's `make` accepts any integer type (`int32`, `uint`, etc.), whereas generic `hy_n5_make` takes `int`; this PR wraps non-literal lengths/capacities in `int(...)`.
   - **Part 2 (Read sites B1–B5):** Remains open in #1206 as designed.

**Payout wallet (USDC on Solana):** `HcrbB5njK3AAbyJEpmQpZuYmBQrv6uNwbj1pZ3dSusPA`
